attempts.scope: Fresh source-blind narrow final claims plus three retained CT witnesses
attempts.result:
## Verdict

Internally the arithmetic holds (50 records × 6 codes = 300 cells), but three claims are stated at a confidence the artifact cannot carry. All three CT witnesses do not survive the definition given.

## Necessary corrections

**1. "Four separate unknown counter definitions" forbids a single unknown figure.**
Four definitions means four incommensurable counters. They cannot be summed, averaged, or reported as "the unknowns" in the 300-cell grid. Correction: attach a definition ID to every unknown count, report them as four parallel series, and designate one as operative for any comparison. Until that is done, no unknown-rate statement about the 300 cells is well-formed.

**2. The evidence base is 50/110, not 95/110.**
No new reading occurred, so 95/110 is an inherited coverage figure, unverified in this artifact — and only 50 records were recoded. Every cell-level count therefore rests on 50 items (≈45% of corpus, ≈53% of read material), first-five chapters only. Correction: state 50/110 as the denominator for all coded claims; keep 95/110 explicitly labeled as carried-forward, non-reverified. With whole-P3 and sample-final false, no saturation, stability, or corpus-rate claim is available.

**3. "Ten official P1 evidence pairs" overstates status, and CT has at most one clean witness.**
With all manuscript gates false and P3 false, "official" can only mean *logged and unadjudicated*. Relabel accordingly.

Against the stated definition (a choice linked to another actor bearing a cost):

| Witness | Verdict |
|---|---|
| 나 혼자만 레벨업 ch.4 — hypothesis/rule gap causes others' failure cost | **Borderline.** Cost is a downstream consequence of an epistemic gap; no choice is identified as the link. Reads as a mechanism note, not CT. |
| 홈 플레이트의 빌런 ch.3 — declares overseas move, separates parents' worry from support | **Fails.** Disclosure and dialogue-sorting only; no actor is shown bearing a cost. Recode or drop. |
| 닥터, 조선 가다 ch.2 — family cooperation set as the cost of the treatment choice | **Passes.** Choice, linked actor, and borne cost all present. |

So CT stands on one clear witness plus one borderline. If a P1 pair requires two qualifying witnesses, CT cannot yet ground one; the ten-pair count must be reduced by any pair resting on these three.

## Standing limits

Paraphrases are recorded, not quoted, and locators are chapter-level — blind verification of code fit is impossible for the borderline case. And per your own stipulation, every figure here is a count of recorded observations, not a body frequency; that qualifier must travel with each number rather than appear once in a preamble.
